name: EPIC 247240677
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 17.7 solar radii and 1.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 247240677 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 17.673801 (16th-84th percentiles 16.510114-18.488299), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 1,685 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.92 solar masses and 17.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,727 K at its surface.
